ViewObject.Name: TotalHasrReportRVO
ViewObject.SQLQuery:
SELECT NVL (COUNT_GONAH, 0) COUNT_GONAH, NVL (COUNT_GENAYAT, 0) COUNT_GENAYAT, NVL (TAB1.GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, TAB2.GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME) GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, NVL (TAB2.PARENT_ENTITY_NAME, TAB1.PARENT_ENTITY_NAME) PARENT_ENTITY_NAME, NVL (TAB1.USER_NAME, TAB2.USER_NAME) USER_NAME FROM ( select COUNT (FOLD.ID) COUNT_GONAH, GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, paren.ENTITY_NAME PARENT_ENTITY_NAME, USR.USERNAME USER_NAME, PAREN.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FOLD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN, ENTITY Master, SEC_USERS USR
where (POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 3) or POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 3 and EXC_ERRAND_FLAG = 'Y') or ( POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID in ((select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 39)) or POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 39) or POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 39) )
))
AND ( FOLD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind,
'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') +1 OR to_char(FOLD.CREATED_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') =:createdDateBind) and FOLD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND FOLD.CREATED_BY = USR.USERNAME AND FOLD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 GROUP BY PAREN.ID,
GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME, USR.USERNAME) TAB1
FULL OUTER JOIN ( select COUNT (FOLD.ID) COUNT_GENAYAT, GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, paren.ENTITY_NAME PARENT_ENTITY_NAME, USR.USERNAME USER_NAME, PAREN.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FOLD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN, ENTITY Master, SEC_USERS USR
where (POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 3) or POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 3 and EXC_ERRAND_FLAG = 'Y') or ( POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID in ((select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 39)) or POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 39) or POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID in (select id from entity where ID = :gozeyaIdBind and :entity_degree = 39) )
))
AND ( FOLD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind,
'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') +1 OR to_char(FOLD.CREATED_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') =:createdDateBind) and FOLD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND FOLD.CREATED_BY = USR.USERNAME AND FOLD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 2 GROUP BY PAREN.ID,
GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME, USR.USERNAME) TAB2 ON TAB1.ID = TAB2.ID
